name: @adyen/agent-marketplace-tui-qa
description: Black-box PTY QA workbench for the agent-marketplace TUI. QA-only tooling; never a production dependency.

scripts.check: npm run unit && npm run build && npm run typecheck:tests && npm run driver
scripts.driver: npm run build && node scripts/clean.mjs .tui-test && tui-test tests/pty-driver.spec.ts
scripts.unit: node scripts/clean.mjs dist-tests && tsc -p tsconfig.unit.json && node --test dist-tests/tests/unit/*.test.js
